answer_text:
Here are some funny and fascinating weird habits that many people have — and you might even recognize yourself in a few of them!

---

### 1. 🎨 Doodling During Phone Calls
Some people doodle during phone calls to help keep themselves focused, and sometimes they don't even know they're doing it until they're off the phone.

---

### 2. 🗣️ Talking to Inanimate Objects
Many people have the habit of talking to inanimate objects — like apologizing to a table after accidentally bumping into it, or yelling at a laptop when it freezes at an important moment.

---

### 3. 🚿 Rehearsing Arguments in the Shower
The shower seems to be the perfect place to rehearse arguments. The most brilliant comebacks for past conflicts always seem to surface while shampooing your hair — long after the moment has passed.

---

### 4. 📱 Stalking Your Own Social Media
Some people scroll through their own Instagram or Facebook profile as if they were their own biggest fan — casually going through their posts, checking the number of likes, and feeling like a celebrity reading the comments.

---

### 5. 🌙 Running from the Dark
Some people bolt toward their room as soon as they switch off the hall light, convinced that if they ever look back, something creepy from a horror movie will be right behind them.

---

### 6. 🗑️ Folding Trash Neatly
Some people fold their trash — any pieces of paper, foil, chip bags, candy wrappers, paper towels, or gum wrappers — folding everything into a neat square once they're done with the contents inside.

---

### 7. 🛑 Telling Objects to "Stay"
Some people point at a breakable object or something they don't want to misplace and tell it to "stay" out loud, like you would to a dog. They never thought it was weird until someone saw them do it and asked if they were afraid it would walk off.

---

### 8. 🥫 Tapping the Can Before Opening It
Some people tap the lid of a can three times before opening it when drinking a Coke or beer — without even knowing why or that they were doing it, until someone pointed it out and assumed it was for luck.

---

### 9. 😴 Faking Sleep to Avoid Conversation
The moment some people hear footsteps approaching, they instantly fake being asleep like they're in a coma — whether they're trying to avoid an awkward conversation or just perfecting their acting skills.

---

### 10. 🥛 Shaking Store-Bought Milk
Some people shake milk jugs before pouring a glass or putting it over cereal. One person explained they were raised on a dairy farm where it was necessary with fresh milk, and they were about 30 before someone asked why — when they realized they didn't need to do it with store-bought milk.

---

### 11. 🍽️ Eating Foods Separately
Some people eat all the items on their plate separately — for example, eating all the chicken before moving on to the broccoli — and don't realize it's considered weird until someone points it out.

---

### 12. 🍫 Extreme Eating Habits (Pica)
On the more extreme end, some people have a habit of eating non-food items like dirt or chalk, which is known as pica.

---

As humans, we're all odd in our own ways, but many of our tendencies are more common than you might think! So the next time you catch yourself doing something quirky, just remember — you're probably not alone! 😄
